briefdescription.para: Test-only helper that corrupts a serialized snapshot field in place.

detaileddescription.para: Writes the integral value into buf at offset using little-endian byte order. If the write would exceed the buffer bounds the helper records a test failure via ADD_FAILURE() and returns without modifying the buffer.
